guides.title: Workspace Setup
guides.description: Create a workspace, configure your brand and customer questions, and complete your first measurement.
guides.beforeYouStart: Have your brand name, website, product or service category, target country, and a few customer questions ready. Creating or cloning a workspace requires an organization admin.

guides.title: Workspace Deep Analysis
guides.description: See which prompts need work, find out why from the answers and the pages they cite, and turn the findings into a plan in Actions Hub.
guides.beforeYouStart: Workspace Deep Analysis is available on every plan, subject to your plan's monthly Deep Analysis allowance. Each prompt needs at least one completed monitoring run in the last 14 days; three or more give a better result. If you still need to add prompts or run a measurement, start with Workspace Setup.
